title: TierListData
description: The versioned payload the plugin embeds in the compiled tier list HTML.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version of this payload. Bumped whenever the shape changes.

tiers.description: Every Tier in Tier Config order.

lanes.description: One Lane per Tier in config order, then the Unranked Lane last.

books.description: Every book on the board, keyed by calibre book id as a string.

series.description: Each series on the board, keyed by series name.

covers.description: Each cover embedded once, keyed by book id as a string. A book with no entry has no cover and is drawn in the Placeholder style with a "no cover" mark.

at.description: When the compile ran, ISO 8601 with offset.

tier.description: The Tier id of this Lane, or null for the Unranked Lane.

items.description: The Stacks and Cards in this Lane, in Lane Order: stored places first, then unplaced items by date read ascending, undated last, then name or title, then id.

stack.description: Series name (key of series) of a Stack in this Lane.

card.description: Book id (key of books) of a standalone Card in this Lane.

series.description: Series name (key of series), or null for a standalone book.

seriesIndex.description: The series index as a reader sees it, e.g. "2.5", or null for a standalone book.

rating.description: Stars out of 5 in half steps, or null when unrated.

blurb.description: The book's comments as plain text, trimmed at a word boundary near 600 characters with an ellipsis; null when empty.

tier.description: Book Tier id, or null when unranked.

dateRead.description: Date read as YYYY-MM-DD, or null when Read State has no date (Yes/No column).

read.description: Whether the book is read, from Read State.

colour.description: Dominant colour of the first owned book with a cover, used to draw this series' Placeholders.

positions.description: Every position of the series, index 1 first; a position with no owned book is a Placeholder.

override.description: True when this series' Series Tier is an Override, false when it is Auto.

number.description: The series index as a reader sees it, e.g. "1" or "2.5".

book.description: Book id (key of books) at this position, or null for a Placeholder.

src.description: data: URI of the 240 px wide thumbnail (AVIF, WebP, or JPEG)
